Definition: to soften (intransitively or transitively), used figuratively
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be tender, be soft, be weak; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be tender, be weak (of heart); 1a1a) to be timid, be fearful; 1a1b) to be softened, be penitent; 1a2) to be soft (of treacherous words); 1b) (Pual) to be softened; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to be weak; 1d) (Niphal) tender
